chapter_title_en: The Grand Tortoise Divine Ability Shakes the Immortal Fortunes Assembly
chapter_seo_title: Immortal Fortunes Assembly: The Grand Tortoise Divine Ability Shocks the Pure Yang True Immortals
chapter_meta_description: The Pure Yang True Immortals are stunned when a slovenly Wanxiang youth unleashes the legendary Grand Tortoise Divine Ability, revealing himself as a personal disciple of a primordial overlord. Meanwhile, Ji Ning enters deep meditation.
og_title: A Primordial Overlord’s Disciple Revealed at the Immortal Fortunes Assembly!
og_description: The Slovenly Realperson steals the show with the Grand Tortoise Divine Ability, sending shockwaves through the entire pantheon of immortals. Ji Ning and the top contenders also make breakthroughs.
twitter_title: The Immortal Fortunes Assembly just got a wildcard: a slovenly kid with a divine ability from a primordial overlord!
twitter_description: The Slovenly Realperson shocks everyone with the Grand Tortoise Divine Ability. Meanwhile, Ji Ning levels up in silence with Yu Wei at his side.

lore_anchors.definition: A supreme divine ability of the Grand Tortoise Emperor, one of the primordial overlords of the Three Realms. Its users display the distinct tortoise-shell pattern and a phantom of a tortoise-serpent.
The eighth major cultivation stage in Ki Refining, representing a True Immortal who has achieved Pure Yang. They are among the highest authorities at the Immortal Fortunes Assembly.
A cultivator who is listed under a major power in name only, qualified to attend lectures but rarely receiving personal guidance or core techniques.
A disciple personally chosen by a major power to receive full resources, secret techniques, and direct mentorship. This identity carries immense prestige and protection.
The Daoist title of Zhang Qi (Sanpang), a Wanxiang Adept of the Black-White College who secretly trained the Grand Tortoise Divine Ability and became the center of attention.
The artificial pocket-realm and trial ground for the Immortal Fortunes Assembly, where geniuses fight for talismans and immortal fortune over many months.
The path of the Supreme Ultimate, a Grand Dao followed by the Slovenly Realperson, focusing on balance and the interplay of Yin and Yang forces.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Grand Tortoise Divine Ability?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is the signature divine ability of the Grand Tortoise Emperor, a primordial overlord. The ability manifests a tortoise-shell pattern and a phantom of a tortoise and serpent, and its use indicates the user is a personally favored disciple.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why are the Celestial Immortals so shocked by the Slovenly Realperson?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because being taught a signature divine ability at the Wanxiang stage is the privilege of a personal disciple, meaning he has the backing of a top-tier power of the Three Realms, a status most Celestial Immortals can only dream of.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the difference between a nominal and personal disciple?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A nominal disciple can listen to lectures but gets almost no personal attention from the master. A personal disciple receives direct teaching, secret techniques, and full resource backing.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the Slovenly Realperson a rival to Ji Ning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In this arc, Sanpang is one of several top contenders. He follows the Taiji Grand Dao, a different path from Ji Ning's Sword Dao, and his divine ability sets him apart as a major threat in the tournament.
